study.title: Maize Rwanda 2023A
study.description: On-farm trials implemented under the scope of 1000FARMS project to introduce new varieties in the Rwanda seed systems.
study.objective: Comparing different maize varieties across 4 Mega-environments in Rwanda. These MEs are Highlands (>1900 masl), Transitional (1700 - 1900 masl), Low-mid Wet (<1700 masl in the wet part of the country), and Low-mid Dry (<1700 masl in the dry part of the country).
